state_summary.problem: A Portal exit is followed by a pagehide save whose snapshot and run flags are inconsistent.
state_summary.expected: Exiting a run should preserve its already saved BEST/statistics and should not restore it as an active run.
observed: The Portal handler marks the run inactive/reported and clears its saved snapshot.
The registered pagehide handler subsequently calls persist, which assigns the still-playing snake to the saved snapshot.
The validator rejects a playing snapshot whose run active flag is false.
unknown: The exit path has not yet been exercised in a compiled browser.
state_summary.operation: Portal link click then browser pagehide
state_summary.provenance: Actual author code inspection before changing this finding.

codex_independent_judgment.rationale: Preserved initial persist excerpt writes a still-playing snake after recordEnd has set active false/reported true. Current validator requires active to match playing and rejects that original combination; SnakeSaveStore.read falls back to blankSave and loses saved BEST/run statistics as well as rejecting the abandoned run. This is a material persistence defect. Current captureSave keeps snapshot null when the run is inactive and snake is still playing, preserving stats across pagehide. Browser Portal→pagehide→reload still needs confirmation.

actual_next_action.description: Read the retained original code excerpt and current Portal/end/pagehide/capture/validation/storage flow. Verified invalid original flags would fall back to blank stats and current capture omits abandoned playing snapshot. No browser execution.
